intro: David Trias is the Forsaken rogue trainer stationed in Deathknell. He instructs freshly awakened undead in the arts of stealth, subterfuge, and bladecraft to aid Queen Sylvanas and the Forsaken.

p: Positioned amidst the tombstones and ruins of Deathknell, David Trias is tasked with identifying and training those newly risen undead who possess a talent for unseen murder. For the fledgling Forsaken, survival requires more than sheer force of arms; it demands precise strikes from the dark. Trias decrypts orders and teaches initiates how to wield daggers, conceal their movements, and turn their reanimated reflexes into lethal precision against the living and the Scourge.
